records.question: In Henry's collection of music CDs, he has 3 more country CDs than rock CDs but twice as many rock CDs as classical CDs. If he has 23 country CDs, how many classical CDs make up his collection?
records.response:
If Henry has 23 country CDs, then he has 23 - 3 = 20 rock CDs.
Since he has twice as many rock CDs as classical CDs, he has 20 / 2 = 10 classical CDs.
#### 10

records.question: There are three trees in the town square. The tallest tree is 150 feet tall. The middle height tree is 2/3 the height of the tallest tree. The shortest tree is half the size of the middle tree.  How tall is the shortest tree?
records.response:
The middle tree is 2/3 of the tallest tree, so it is 2/3 * 150 = 100 feet tall.
The shortest tree is half the size of the middle tree, so it is 100 / 2 = 50 feet tall.
